content.rendered:
It’s time for our AG Carnival next week on Friday, April 28th. We need your help to make it a huge success starting on Thursday afternoon!

Volunteer Opportunities:

Set Up, Thursday, April 27th from 1:45 pm – 6:00 pm

Set Up, Friday, April 28th from 8:00 am – 4:00 pm

Carnival Day evening, Friday, April 28th from 4:00 pm – 8:00 pm running different games, food or activity booths. 

Clean Up from 8:00 pm – 9:30 pm on Friday, April 28th

If you are available to help in any of these areas please sign up via the helpcounter app or email Lyndsey at Lyndseyabrewer@gmail.com or call her at (971) 235-0573
